paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.33b.4): Ravina permitted him to put beer into it, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Ravina gives Rav Chiyya son of Rav Yitzchak permission to put beer into the vessel. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1264&lang=en) cites the same permission.
